import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginating through all pages."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

import httpx


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    titles = []
    status = "open"
    url = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": status, "project": project}

    while url is not None:
        response = client.get(url, params=params)
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        items = data.get("items", [])
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in items)
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if next_url is None:
            break
        # next_url is relative, so set url to next_url and keep params with status and project
        url = next_url
        # params remain the same for each request (status and project)
    return titles

def make_proxied_client(proxy_url: str, base_url: str) -> httpx.Client:

import httpx
from typing import List


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> List[str]:
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"

    while url is not None:
        response = client.get(url, params=params)
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        items = data.get("items", [])
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in items)
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if next_url is None:
            break
        # next_url is relative and requires the same query params again
        url = next_url
        # params must be resent on every request (including next pages)
        # so keep params unchanged for next request

    return titles
